scientific_question: Can a physical-twin correction be continuously monitored, promoted, revoked, and optionally re-entered while controlling the probability of any false promotion under optional stopping for a registered clipped paired loss?

guarantee.null: For every fallback epoch, the conditional mean clipped normalized fallback-minus-candidate gain is at most gain_margin given the revealed past.
guarantee.e_process: A fixed convex mixture of products prod_t(1+lambda*x_t), where x_t=(gain_t-gain_margin)/(1+gain_margin).
guarantee.familywise_statement: Ville's inequality within each epoch and the telescoping alpha budget bound the probability of at least one false admission over arbitrarily many monitored times and re-entry epochs by alpha.
guarantee.delayed_feedback: The candidate and fallback forecasts are both frozen before each outcome; paired loss is revealed later and can change deployment only for subsequent decisions.
guarantee.boundary: The guarantee applies to the registered clipped loss and conditional-mean null. It is not an unclipped-risk, arbitrary-distribution, causal-identification, physical-validity, deployment-safety, or collision-safety guarantee.

comparators.naive_repeated_z: A conventional one-sided z threshold is checked after every reveal without multiplicity correction; it is intentionally not anytime-valid.
comparators.fixed_horizon_z: The same one-sided z threshold is evaluated only once at the registered horizon.
comparators.unguarded: Deploy the candidate from the first decision and never revoke.
comparators.fixed_source_guard: A one-time source decision that cannot react to a later domain shift.

primary_readouts: power and median admission delay under beneficial gain
revocation fraction and delay after abrupt harmful shift
cumulative clipped regret relative to exact fallback

implementation: every emitted e-value and boundary is finite or positive infinity by contract
controlled_mechanism: anytime-valid admission is no more frequent than the naive repeated test in both zero-mean nulls
the shifted scenario has nonzero admission and nonzero subsequent revocation
re-entry epoch budgets are strictly decreasing and have total at most alpha
promotion_gate.claim_boundary: Passing supports the sequential mechanism and optional-stopping theorem implementation. It does not by itself establish real-data utility or make a deployment-safety claim.

requirements: candidate and fallback forecasts must both be frozen before outcome access
loss_cap and all thresholds must be selected without target-outcome tuning
reveal order must be chronological or generated independently of outcome values
candidate identity must remain fixed inside one evidence stream
